description: v1-minimal static discovery manifest — a machine-readable listing, not a registry service. No database, no auth, no search API behind this file; a real registry (third-party publishing, search, freshness checks) is named roadmap, not a silently narrower scope pretending to be complete.

facilitators.name: Konfirm x402 Facilitator
facilitators.description: A compliance-aware x402 facilitator for the Stellar `exact` scheme: standard Soroban auth-entry verification and settlement (via the official @x402/stellar reference implementation), plus Konfirm's own local-blocklist + on-chain compliance check on every verify/settle call — the same check already protecting Konfirm's Freighter checkout and SEP-7/QR payment paths.

resources.description: Local example paid resource used to verify this facilitator end-to-end (see scripts/x402-harness/resource-server.js). Not a hosted, always-on resource — a proof harness, listed here so the manifest schema has one real, runnable entry rather than a hypothetical one.
